basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old DIY enthusiast and gadget lover from Portland, Oregon. By day, I'm a freelance graphic designer, and by night, I indulge in various hobbies like woodworking, vaping, and exploring anarchist literature. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. I'm single, enjoy going to local meetups, and have a keen interest in sustainable living practices.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, which I studied at a local community college. Over the years, I've taught myself about vaping and torch maintenance through online forums and hands-on experimentation. My interest in anarchism stems from reading extensively and participating in community discussions.
